test_cases.title: Retrieve Hotel Branding Details
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/branding returns HTTP status 200 OK along with hotel name, map coordinates, description, and contact information.

steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and JSON contains hotel name 'Shady Meadows B&B', map coordinates, description, and contact/address information

test_cases.overall_expected_result: API request succeeds and returns valid branding JSON payload

test_cases.title: Retrieve Room List
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/room returns HTTP status 200 OK and a JSON list of rooms containing roomName, type, accessible, and roomPrice.

steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns a JSON list containing room properties such as roomName, type, accessible, and roomPrice

test_cases.overall_expected_result: API request succeeds and returns valid room list payload

test_cases.title: Retrieve Specific Room Details by Valid ID
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/room/{id} with a valid room ID returns HTTP status 200 OK with the room details.
preconditions: A valid room ID exists (e.g., room ID 1)

steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns specific room details JSON

test_cases.overall_expected_result: API request succeeds and returns valid room detail payload

test_cases.title: Negative: Retrieve Specific Room Details with Non-Existent ID
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/room/{id} with a non-existent room ID returns HTTP status 404 Not Found.
test_cases.overall_expected_result: API properly handles non-existent room ID with 404 status

test_cases.title: Admin Login with Valid Credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials from input/api_credentials.json returns HTTP status 200 OK and a valid token string.
preconditions: Valid admin credentials exist in input/api_credentials.json

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/auth/login with valid credentials
steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns a response containing a valid token string

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Authentication succeeds and provides a valid token

test_cases.title: Validate Authentication Token
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/auth/validate with the generated token returns HTTP status 200 OK with {"valid": true}.
preconditions: A valid authentication token has been obtained via POST /api/auth/login

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/auth/validate passing the retrieved token
steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns JSON payload {"valid": true}

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Token is successfully validated by the API

test_cases.title: Negative: Admin Login with Invalid Credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns HTTP status 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/auth/login with invalid username and password
steps.expected_result: Response status is 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Authentication request is rejected for invalid credentials

test_cases.title: Negative: Admin Login with Empty Credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with empty or missing credentials returns an error status code (400 or 401).

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/auth/login with empty credentials
steps.expected_result: Response status is 400 Bad Request or 401 Unauthorized

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Authentication request is rejected when credentials are empty

test_cases.title: Create Contact Message
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/message with valid contact payload creates a message and returns HTTP status 200 or 201.

payload.name: John Doe
payload.subject: Booking Inquiry
payload.description: I would like to inquire about room availability for next weekend.

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/message with valid payload
steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 or 201 Created indicating successful message creation

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Contact message is successfully created via API

test_cases.title: Retrieve Message Count
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/message/count returns HTTP status 200 OK with a non-negative count property.
preconditions: Authenticated admin session or valid authorization if required

steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns JSON containing a non-negative count property

test_cases.title: Negative: Create Contact Message with Missing Mandatory Fields
test_cases.description: Verify that POST /api/message with missing mandatory fields returns HTTP status 400 Bad Request.

steps.action: Send HTTP POST request to /api/message with missing mandatory fields

test_cases.overall_expected_result: API rejects message creation when mandatory fields are missing

test_cases.title: Retrieve Bookings by Room ID
test_cases.description: Verify that GET /api/booking?roomid=1 returns HTTP status 200 OK with a list of bookings containing bookingid, roomid, firstname, lastname, and bookingdates.

steps.expected_result: Response status is 200 and returns a list of bookings where each entry contains bookingid, roomid, firstname, lastname, and bookingdates

test_cases.overall_expected_result: API request succeeds and returns valid booking list for the specified room
